integrity: All critical moment closures and rational-transform identities are reconstructed in a standalone checker. Finite numerical checks illustrate, but do not establish, global statements. No independent audit or independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only an isotropic, independent, fixed-speed spherical-direction Poisson-refresh propulsion process in a harmonic trap, at stationary initial law. A sign of one fourth-order time-order contrast does not characterize total irreversibility. The proof covers all integer d>=1 and positive gamma/kappa; extension to other dynamics is unproved. Prior literature supplies stationary moments and general resolvent tools; the exact dimension-dependent sign theorem requires independent priority examination.
title: A dimension-five onset and a unique reversal in the fourth-order time arrow of a trapped run-and-tumble particle
